name: Emergency-water source boundary
identityStatus: semantic boundary; physical tag and battery limit unresolved
processFunction: Portfolio boundary for independent emergency-water obligations; no shared header or capacity is established.
reviewFindings: Dedicated potable, tempered source, treatment, storage and distribution topology are undefined; no common header is established.
Station flow, pressure, simultaneous demand, duration, pipe sizing and residual pressure are unverified.
Tempering, delivered temperature, heat tracing, insulation, freeze protection and cold-weather availability are unresolved.
Backflow prevention, branch isolation, test connections, dead-leg control and maintenance bypass are unresolved.
Compatible runoff destinations and capacity are unresolved; no reactive-spill, wastewater or storm connection is claimed.
Locations are planning reservations; exposure points, walking time, actuator reach and elevated-work coverage remain unapproved.
Supplier selection, spray pattern, hands-free operation, signage, training, tests and commissioning are unavailable.
Battery limits, utility ownership, isolation and interfaces with A-4000/A-5000/A-6000 argon remain unresolved.
